material_change: All seven fields that were MISSING before Issue #127 now have direct first-party evidence, but the evidence does not justify promoting the complete candidate to an executable deterministic rule.

field_assessment.INPUTS: PARTIAL: observable FVG/FVA/PD Array/2CR constructions remain incomplete.
field_assessment.INSTRUMENTS: PARTIAL: direct Gold and NQ examples exist, with Metals/Indices/JPY pairs named as favorable classes; universal eligibility is not defined.
field_assessment.TIMEFRAME: PARTIAL: direct 4h/1h and 4h-FVG/1h-FVA/15m-execution examples exist; no universal hierarchy is defined.
field_assessment.HIGHER_TIMEFRAME_CONTEXT: PARTIAL: LTF entry inside HTF expansion is explicit; HTF-ready construction remains incomplete.
field_assessment.DIRECTION: PARTIAL: recovered long examples map resistance/2CR-high runs to bullish continuation; the complete direction algorithm remains incomplete.
field_assessment.PRECONDITIONS: PARTIAL: opposing arguments must be removed; full argument inventory and weighting are incomplete.
field_assessment.SETUP: PARTIAL: AoO is Trigger-to-Target and HTF/LTF placement is explicit; exact PD Array selection remains incomplete.
field_assessment.TRIGGER: PARTIAL: Run on Liquidity / Run 2CR High is explicit with close-above and two-sting examples; Arjo presents more than one valid run construction.
field_assessment.ENTRY: PARTIAL: trade-into-AoO implies entry and 15m execution is directly exemplified; order/fill/confirmation timing is not uniquely specified.
field_assessment.STOP: PARTIAL: stop belongs where the setup becomes low-probability and a bearish Swing-High example is explicit; the long-side numeric rule is not directly specified.
field_assessment.TARGET: PARTIAL: target must be a PD Array and an NQ long example targets the next ATH; PD Array taxonomy/tie-breaks remain incomplete.
field_assessment.INVALIDATION: PARTIAL: a rejection-high run invalidates respect; post-entry invalidation remains under-specified.
field_assessment.EXPIRY: PARTIAL: unmet parameters are abandoned and trading is limited to WoO; no universal exact bar/clock expiry is stated.
field_assessment.SESSION/TIME_RULE: PARTIAL: trading within WoO is required, but WoO may be a configured session or alert-driven rather than one universal clock interval.
field_assessment.OPTIONAL_CONDITIONS: PARTIAL: a December avoid-trading filter is documented; the complete optional-filter set is not stated.
field_assessment.REQUIRED_CONDITIONS: PARTIAL: competing arguments must be removed and Bias/Narrative/Context/Entry/Risk Management are explicit plan levels; exact rules for every level remain incomplete.

critical_first_party_boundary: Arjo explicitly states that a trading plan needs an 80/20 rule: 80% objective and 20% subjective. A faithful autonomous engine therefore cannot silently invent the subjective 20%; it must either recover direct operational rules for it or expose those judgments as explicit reviewed configuration/policy.
next_recovery_targets: Direct long-side stop placement tied to the selected AoO/PD Array entry.
Exact PD Array construction and target tie-breaking for the narrowed NQ plan.
Exact HTF-ready / expansion predicate and LTF entry confirmation timing.
Explicit expiry policy when a parameter is not met inside the configured WoO.
Evidence identifying which judgments constitute the stated subjective 20%, or an owner-approved deterministic policy for those judgments.
